norms.what: Written in 0.8.0 as the third per-transition command, the shape of `audit-opus-5-5` and `audit-sonnet-5-5`: it only starts the transition-agnostic audit with its slug, so a user can name the move without knowing the general command's argument form. The slug is `haiku-4-5-to-5-5` because the migration guide moves code from Claude Haiku 4.5 to Claude Haiku 5.5, and there is no Claude Haiku 5; the command says so because the request that started this transition named a Haiku 5 that does not exist (#135).
